name: Zombie Crisis Demo
summary:
Zombie Crisis DEMO is a fast-paced action experience designed to test your reflexes and keep your adrenaline high.

This is a demo version of the game, created to let you jump straight into the action and have fun without pressure.
You have infinite lives, so there’s no fear of starting over — feel free to experiment, improve your skills, and take down as many zombies as you can.

But don’t lower your guard.
